# Schema Therapy Society e.V. (ISST)

> The International Society of Schema Therapy (ISST) is a professional organization providing membership, certified therapist directories, training programs, and certification standards for schema therapy practitioners worldwide.

ISST serves as the global governing body for schema therapy, offering membership tiers, approved training programs across multiple countries, and a directory of certified therapists. The organization maintains rigorous training policies and certification standards while facilitating professional development and international collaboration among mental health practitioners.
